next_step_summary: PR #217 is an owner-authorized validation-harness corrective after the first real-device smoke exposed two usability blockers: the bounded source/result images were too small for meaningful visual inspection and repeated testing lacked nearby select-next/reset controls. PR #217 adds only full-screen inspection of the existing local bounded preview/full-frame result, Select another photo, Reset, and preserves the current result when the picker is canceled. Native geometry algorithms, thresholds, safe crop, OCR recognition, network/data flow, dependencies, permissions, workflows and persistence are unchanged. Next run android-geometry-current-block-device-smoke-v1 on the two owner-controlled actually photographed test-contract sets, checking angle decision/sign, applied rotation, visible improvement and meaningful-edge preservation. If no concrete base-geometry defect is found, resume android-geometry-safe-crop-v1.
